verdict.rationale: The MCP evidence is client-side. Gumloop agents can connect to any MCP server (docs-7/33), and Proxied MCPs bring external servers into Gumloop. Hosted MCPs (docs-8/48) let enterprises deploy their own custom-coded MCP servers on Gumloop's infrastructure, but nothing shows Gumloop workflows, agents or connected app actions being exposed as MCP tools for an external agent to call. The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to the client-connection page, so it does not count as evidence for this story.
